serve: cfg=$(mktemp) && printf '%s\n' '{"pinned":[{"tracker":"github","repo":"AbysmalBiscuit/project-flow"}]}' > "$cfg" && counts=$(gh issue list -R AbysmalBiscuit/project-flow --state all --limit 200 --json stateReason,state | bun -e 'const rows=await Bun.stdin.json(); let done=0, dropped=0, backlog=0; for (const row of rows) { if (row.state==="OPEN") backlog+=1; else if (row.stateReason==="NOT_PLANNED" || row.stateReason==="DUPLICATE") dropped+=1; else done+=1; } console.log(`Done ${done} Dropped ${dropped} Backlog ${backlog}`) ') && test "$counts" = "Done 1 Dropped 0 Backlog 16" && GITHUB_TOKEN="$(gh auth token)" exec bun /home/lev/Git/lev/project-flow_workspaces/2-feat-serve-one-github-repo-as-a-project/src/main.ts --config "$cfg" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173
